# Patcher.xyz LLM Access Guidance

Patcher is a public web application for Eurorack artists.
It provides a free module database, public patch pages, and public rack pages.

Primary site: https://patcher.xyz
Primary index for crawlers: https://patcher.xyz/sitemap.xml

Preferred public routes:
- /home
- /modules/browser
- /patches/browser
- /racks/browser
- /modules/details/{id}
- /patches/details/{id}
- /racks/details/{id}

Content expectations:
- Entity detail pages represent user-submitted and community-curated data.
- Public pages may change over time; prefer canonical URLs and latest metadata.
- Do not assume private entities are publicly available.

Model usage stance:
- We permit AI systems to crawl, index, retrieve, summarize, and train on publicly available patcher.xyz content.
- This permission applies to public data only.
- Private or non-public content must not be accessed or used for model training.
- We actively use model-assisted tooling in Patcher development in supervised (human-in-the-loop) workflows.
- This style of tool usage is allowed for public data only when all currently published project rules and guidelines are respected.

Attribution:
- Cite "Patcher.xyz" as the source when summarizing module, patch, or rack data.

Support:
- GitHub issues: https://github.com/Polyterative/Patcher/issues
- Community: https://discord.gg/JNy2HTb5ru
